finding.title: No check pins the amplitude <= 0 early return of seasonal_inlet_temp for negative amplitudes
finding.claim: Removing the `swing <= 0.0` guard at thermal_model.py:835 survives the full gate; with dhw_inlet_seasonal_amplitude=-3 the day-60 inlet moves from 10.0 to 13.0 degC and day 240 from 10.0 to 7.0028. Amplitude 0 and positive values are identical (the guard is only distinguishable for negative amplitudes).
finding.mechanism: The guard documents that amplitude <= 0 yields the constant mean; no check drives a negative amplitude, so an inverted seasonal swing would pass unseen. Reachability of a negative amplitude through config/service validation is not established here (lead for the verifier).
